notes.title: ANIME STANDING finally coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/16Sqycb.gif[/img]

[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2]

[h3]Hope you're all doing well during these times.[/h3]

Our apologies for a long silence in releasing the game! Anime Standing was a long awaited project, which release date we had to postpone for quite a while, unfortunately. 

Regardless, we are now happy to inform that we are currently on a stage of working on fine details. And we have already sent the game for a review. It is now better, more grand and complex!

Despite how long it’d been, we plan to release Anime Standing on [b]1st of May[/b]. It’s only just a little more time before the game will be finally available!

[h3]Add the game to your Steam Wishlist and leave your feedback!

Stay safe,
Konnichiwa Games[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253870/ANIME_STANDING/

notes.title: Unpade 4: new weapon for everybody!
notes.content:
We wanted to introduce you our newest weapon of choice: when near the enemies just hit him hard with a [b]trench shove[/b]l and.. well, it's deadly. (hit the number 6)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TncuOSR.gif[/img]

Besides, there is one more hidden secret option of dealing with those guys.. You can always choose to randomly through a [b]grenade[/b] their way.. and enjoy the show! (just hit the G button)

notes.content:
